decisions.reason: The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY recording retention of R7 and R8 and their DW01A protection functions.
Approval of the DW01A resistors does not change the NTC terminal, connector, function, or thermal-protection controller.
Retaining the identified resistors does not change the approved four-layer stack.
The component-retention decision does not alter connector placement, orientation, access, or mounting-hole clearance.
The decision does not change the board dimensions, orientation, aspect ratio, USB-C placement, or mounting constraints.
The retained protection components do not affect the SK6812-based charge-status interface.
The decision does not modify the interboard connector partition, connector types, signal pinout, or pin-order policy.
Approval of the resistors has no necessary effect on USB-C part selection or sourceability.
The source decision does not change the addressable-LED family or its data GPIO.
The retained DW01A and I2C-related resistors do not change the boost converter, enable control, powered loads, or interboard routing.
The component-retention approval does not alter the battery connector family, pitch, pin count, pin functions, or part number.
The accepted proposal explicitly retains the existing 0-ohm I2C resistors used for voltage-spike conditioning, which is not represented in the candidate state.
